messages:
ana_newhire: hey team — quick Q on Notion layout. i'm keeping daily ramp notes + a couple small how-tos. where do we put "personal" ramp notes vs stuff that should be canonical? also how do i request edit rights on the onboarding templates without breaking the canonical copy?
cory_devex: welcome Ana! personal ramp notes = Notion 'My Pages' or a private subpage under Team Docs > Onboarding > Private Ramps. canonical team docs live in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and need a docs-review before edits.
pat_docs: @ana_newhire to request edits, please make a personal copy of the template, apply your changes, then open a docs-review PR from your copy. Docs maintainers will review and bump the template version if approved. We keep canonical templates locked to prevent accidental drift.
nana_newhire: (typo) meant @pat_docs — got it. is there a naming convention for personal copies so managers can find them during 1:1s?
sara_manager: we ask folks to title them: "Ramp — Ana L (private)" and add a property 'Visibility' = private, tags #ramp #private. if you want me to check weekly, share the page with me as Viewer.
pat_docs: template versioning: we use a 'Template Version' property and keep a changelog on the canonical page. If you propose structural changes (sections, required props), include a 1-2 line rationale in your docs-review PR. Small wording tweaks can often be merged by docs maintainers without changing the version.
cory_devex: to request edit rights temporarily (if you need to edit the canonical template directly), open a DevEx request: https://redwood.com/devex/request -> Notion edit access. Note: SSO/SCIM approval may take up to 20 minutes and we require a short justification.
sys_bot: System: Notion invite for Team Docs editors queued. SCIM sync pending.
pat_docs: quick tip: if you want to keep drafts but avoid duplicates, create a single canonical draft page under your private area and link to it from any how-to pages. When ready to promote, use Move > Team Docs and open docs-review.
nana_newhire: thanks everyone! i'll make a private copy called "Ramp — Ana L (Week1)" and open a PR if i want to promote anything. pinging @pat_docs if i run into SSO issues. :pray:
